title: Repo Federation Manifest
description: A producer node's self-declaration, consumed by the Hub (thehub-pr). Lives at each producer repo root as federation.json. This is the discovery + callable-interface contract.

program_id.description: Stable federation node id, e.g. moneysweep-pr, aguayluz-pr, skywatcher-pr.

federation_role.description: Domain role of this node within the federation.

branding.description: Program visual identity. Icons are derived from icon.png by thehub-pr/tools/build_program_icons.py; accent_color is sampled from that artwork.

icon.description: Repo-relative path to the square master PNG.

icon_dir.description: Directory holding the derived icon set (PNGs, icon.ico, AppIcon.icns).

hub_callable_commands.description: Shell commands the Hub may invoke. setup owns only the certified runtime dependency profile. A producer that keeps test tooling outside runtime may declare setup_test; the Hub runs it after setup and before test_suite when setup execution is authorized. setup and setup_test may use the network only to acquire version/SHA-pinned dependencies. Every other command, including test_suite, MUST be offline-safe. Hosted retrieval remains acquisition convenience and does not prove an offline-reproducible build.

canonical_outputs.description: Named output paths the Hub can fetch from this producer.

federation_readiness_gate.description: Gate semantics: a non-empty blocking_conditions list means ready_for_hub_live_execution MUST be false. Conditions that have been resolved belong in resolved_conditions; advisory or domain-specific notes belong outside this gate object.
